channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Indonesia Restricts Social Media for Children Under 16 With New Digital Policy Ensuring Online Safety
item.description: The Indonesian government begins phased rollout of age restrictions on major social media platforms to shield youth.

item.title: Government Halts TRP Reporting for TV News Channels for Four Weeks Over Sensational Israel-Iran War Coverage
item.description: MIB directs BARC to temporarily suspend TV news ratings to curb speculative and panic-inducing war coverage.

item.title: US Stocks Drop as Dow Falls 0.95% and Oil Surges 12% Amid Middle East Conflict
item.description: A weak US labour market and surging oil prices drive Wall Street to its worst weekly performance.

item.title: Meghalaya Probes Suspected Meningococcal Cluster After 2 Agniveer Trainee Deaths in Shillong
item.description: Meghalaya launched an investigation after two Agniveer deaths, with 30 trainees under observation for suspected meningococcal infection.

item.title: India’s Top Court Restricts Stem Cell Procedures For Treating Autism
item.description: The Supreme Court classified stem cells as "drugs" without adequately providing representation to affected families.

item.title: LPG Prices Hiked: Domestic Cylinders Up ₹60, Commercial ₹115 From March 7 Amid Middle East Tensions
item.description: India raises LPG prices nationwide as global tensions disrupt supply chains, increasing pressure on household budgets and small businesses.

item.title: Karnataka: 700 Sheep And Lambs Burnt To Death After Massive Shed Fire In Raichur’s Sindhanur
item.description: A sudden fire at a sheep shed in Karnataka’s Raichur district killed around 700 animals, leaving a livestock rearer facing devastating financial loss.

item.title: Global Oil Markets Rattled as Crude Prices Surge $12 in Just 9 Hours —What Triggered the Spike?
item.description: Oil prices surged $12 in nine hours, rattling markets amid Middle East tensions and supply fears.

item.title: Government Sources Reassure India Has Sufficient Crude Stocks, No Immediate Threat to Fuel Supplies
item.description: India reassures stable fuel supplies as strategic reserves and diversified imports cushion the impact of Middle East tensions.

item.title: Delhi Woman Allegedly Escapes Taxi Driver’s Attempted Sexual Assault Near Nainital; Accused Still Sought
item.description: A 22-year-old woman from Delhi escaped an alleged taxi driver's assault, hiding overnight in a forest.
